Healthcare revenue

Prior authorization.

Give clinical staff administrative support for payer requirements, requests, follow-up and approval expiry dates.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Check and assemble

Confirm whether approval is required for the planned service, establish the payer’s documentation requirements and collect records for provider sign-off.

Submit and track

Requests follow the payer’s preferred route. Each reference, status check and request for additional information is recorded.

Record the decision

Track approval numbers, dates, visit limits and renewal reminders. The practice retains clinical decisions while the partner team manages the paperwork.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Requirements and evidence checklist by payer and service.
  • Submission references and a shared authorisation status log.
  • Expiry reminders, renewal tracking and turnaround reporting.
Delivery partner

US healthcare operations.

Cloud Haven coordinates billing work with SuperBillOne LLC, a US-registered medical billing company in Austin, Texas. Your introductory call covers the practice workflow, payer mix and the responsibilities on each side.

Meet the billing partner
Questions

Before you start.

Who decides whether treatment is clinically appropriate?

Your provider makes the clinical decision. Our role is to check payer requirements, prepare paperwork and track the request.

What happens after an unfavourable decision?

We record the payer’s reason and prepare the appropriate correction or appeal for the provider to review.

Which insurers can be included?

During onboarding the practice and team confirm which payers it bills and which approval workflows are in scope.

Field notes

Further reading.

What is prior authorization?

Some health plans require a practice to request approval before particular services. The administrative task is to check the applicable requirement, prepare the request and follow the payer’s decision.

A prior authorization checklist

A simple tracker helps an administrative team identify what is missing before a planned service and who is responsible for the next action.
